explanation: The statement is about the library's own definitions: AdmitsModulus, conductorExponentAt, localChar and idealMultiplicity for Hecke characters on the adele ring. The proof only combines two of the library's own lemmas, exists_hasConductorExponentAt_le and conductorExponentAt_eq_of_hasConductorExponentAt. As far as I know, Mathlib has no notion of the conductor exponent of a Hecke character at a finite place, so it cannot duplicate this result. I did not run a search, since none of the statement's main constants come from Mathlib.
